statement: Intel Foundry revenue reached $5.8 billion in Q2 2026, up 31% YoY, attributed to improved factory yields and faster cycle times.
why: A second viable leading-edge foundry with improving yields is the main structural relief valve for a supply chain currently bottlenecked at one manufacturer.

impact.mechanism: Rising foundry revenue on better yields and cycle times signals added leading-edge wafer and packaging capacity available to accelerator designers.

evidence.excerpt: Intel Foundry: "$5.8 billion, up 31% YoY," attributed to improved factory yields and faster cycle times.
We delivered a strong second quarter, exceeding our financial guidance on robust demand and improved execution, including volume upside driven by higher factory yields and improved cycle times.

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: Intel's own earnings press release with attributed CFO commentary on the yield and cycle-time drivers.
